mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened financing conditions depressing near-term corporate investment plans.
failure_condition: Over a 5-year sample, the 20-day forward return does not diverge statistically from the pre-rate hike period (t-test p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE by at least 0.2 percentage points for three consecutive months is associated with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market tightening reduces wage growth expectations and supports equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by ≥ 0.2 pp for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: In regimes with high inflation, the 60-day forward return is not statistically significant (p > 0.10) after controlling for CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 (real private consumption) exceeds INDPRO by at least 2% for two consecutive months, it signals robust demand momentum that drives a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative or flat in 70% of such triggered windows over a 4-year sample.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in INDPRO by at least 3% followed within one month by a rise in HOUST by ≥ 5% indicates easing supply constraints in manufacturing, which is associated with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls ≥ 3% in month t, then HOUST rises ≥ 5% in month t+1
regime_hint: Transition from supply shock to recovery
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is not statistically positive (p > 0.10) in 50% of such events over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for three consecutive months in a non-recessionary regime, it predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as low rates encourage risk-on positioning.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of such periods when inflation is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS by at least 10,000 jobs in a month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as large drawdowns in employment signal recession risk and investor caution.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls by ≥ 10,000 in a single month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return does not turn negative within 3 days of the trigger in 80% of such events over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS exceeding 500 million dollars with no decline in UNRATE indicates strong demand resilience, which is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 500M for 2 consecutive months AND UNRATE < 4.5% in both months
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is not statistically positive (p > 0.05) when demand momentum persists but SPX declines anyway.

mechanism_narrative: A double-move in supply indicators: INDPRO falls by ≥ 4% in one month followed by a ≥ 6% drop in GDPC1 the next month, predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as persistent supply weakness depresses growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls ≥ 4% in month t, GDPC1 falls ≥ 6% in month t+1
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in 60% of such double-move events over 5 years.
